package_readiness.assessment: The current portfolio repositories are specification, schema, example, and starter-tooling repositories; they are not yet release-ready installable SDK packages.
package_readiness.result: No root-level pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg, package.json, Cargo.toml, go.mod, pom.xml, or equivalent distribution manifest was found in the seven existing public project repositories reviewed. Their manifest.json files are ecosystem metadata, not package build metadata.
package_readiness.decision: Do not publish empty or premature packages. Add package metadata, reproducible build, license validation, dependency lock/SBOM, artifact signing and install-from-artifact tests only when a repository contains a reusable library or executable intended for distribution.
